description: This file handles clipboard operations within the Excalidraw application, including copying, pasting, and reading clipboard data, supporting various data types such as text, images, and Excalidraw elements.

methods.name: createPasteEvent
methods.description: Creates a synthetic ClipboardEvent with specified types and files for testing or programmatic paste simulation.

methods.name: serializeAsClipboardJSON
methods.description: Serializes Excalidraw elements and associated files into a JSON string suitable for clipboard copying.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies Excalidraw elements and files to the system clipboard asynchronously.

methods.name: readSystemClipboard
methods.description: Reads data from the system clipboard programmatically, supporting text and images.

methods.name: parseClipboard
methods.description: Parses clipboard data from a ClipboardEvent or DragEvent into structured application data.

methods.name: copyBlobToClipboardAsPng
methods.description: Copies a Blob as a PNG image to the clipboard.

methods.name: copyTextToSystemClipboard
methods.description: Copies text to the system clipboard, using various fallback methods if necessary.

methods.name: isClipboardEvent
methods.description: Type guard to check if an event is a ClipboardEvent.
